description: Stress set for isImperativeContent (packages/domain/src/memory/consolidation.ts). Each item is a sentence the Dreaming extractor could plausibly emit as a memory candidate. label=fact: a declarative, durable statement worth keeping (a preference, constraint or decision may legitimately contain words like never/must/必须). label=instruction: imperative phrasing addressed to the agent/reader, which must not enter the ledger unreviewed. Balanced by design (not production prevalence): rates here describe failure modes, not how often they happen in real traffic. Initial labels drafted by Claude; the domain expert (Kim / maintainer) should review rows marked ambiguous before numbers are quoted.
